repos_data.description: The Swiss Army Knife of Offline AI. Chat, Speak, and Generate Images - Privacy First, Zero Internet. Download an LLM and use it on your mobile device. No data ever leaves your phone. Supports text-to-text, vision, text-to-image
Kubernetes operator for local LLM inference with llama.cpp, vLLM, and TGI - multi-GPU, autoscaling, air-gapped, production-ready

localaik is a local compatibility server for a subset of the Gemini and OpenAI APIs. Run one container locally, point your SDK to it, and the proxy serves both protocol shapes on the same port for tests and development.
